where: 4.7.3: 'Soit E le sous-anneau de End(G) engendré par v, qui est un quotient de Z[T]/(T^{p^N}-1)'
scan: Soit E le sous-anneau de End(G) engendré par v, qui est un quotient de Z[T]/(T^{p^N}-1)
tex: Soit $E$ le sous-anneau de $\mathrm{End}(G)$ engendré par $v$, qui est un quotient de $\mathbb{Z}[T]/(T^{p^N}-1)$
note: Only the subring generated by u (u^{p^N} = 1) is a quotient of Z[T]/(T^{p^N}-1); v, with 1-u = nv, satisfies (1-nT)^{p^N} = 1 instead. Probably a slip of the print (v for u); the emendation is conjectural. The TeX keeps the printed reading. Separately, not a transcription matter: Remarque 4.7.5 (p. 368), which reuses this argument for any divisible commutative Group of a topos, fails as printed for G = Q, Gamma = {1,-1}, n >= 3 (there _nG = 0); the step u-1 = 0 mod n needs v integral over Z, which 4.7.1 gets from End(G) being a finitely generated Z-module.

where: first paragraph (end of 4.7.3): 'une racine primitive p^n-ème de l'unité u'
scan: racine primitive p^n-ème de l'unité u
note: Wrong exponent: n is the integer of the hypothesis (u-1 = 0 mod n, n = 2); the exponent is m, as in 'si u≠1 i.e. m ≥1' and 'sauf si p=2,m=1' a few lines below. The TeX keeps the printed reading.

A preposition is missing before the reference (the exposé writes 'faite dans 2.3', 'explicitée dans (4.3.0)'); 'donnée en 4.7.3' is equally possible. The emendation is conjectural. The TeX keeps the printed reading.
